correctness.rationale: For finite U and two genuine partitions P_i,Q_j with all intersections C_ij nonempty, every action of type P_i can output each element of C_ij only against a column action of Q_j, forcing e_j>=q_ij; fixing Q_j symmetrically forces d_i>=q_ij. Disjoint partition cells prevent outcomes from being supplied via a different type. The explicit cyclic table h_ij((a+b) mod q_ij) for positive d_i,e_j meeting these inequalities supplies all q_ij outcomes in every row and column. Because profile rectangles are disjoint, labelled tables factor exactly as product T(q_ij,d_i,e_j), and inclusion-exclusion over missing row/color and column/color events counts T. The componentwise minima are coordinatewise maxima q_ij; at q=a=b the row/column condition is the Latin-square condition. No assertion about overlapping neighborhoods or unlabeled game is included. Verified the checker.py constructs the same cyclic tables and implements independent inclusion-exclusion and exhaustive small-array routines; the finite diagnostics are not proof for all q_ij.
residual_risks: Only two agents, deterministic one-state exact output-set partitions with all cross cells nonempty; no overlap/coalition/unlabeled enumeration.
